5373.title: Marketplace checkout rejects remote-only branch names
5373.rootCauseOneLine: Detached checkout of a remote-only short branch name triggers incompatible implicit local-branch creation.
5373.proposedFix: Resolve the requested ref, with an origin remote-tracking fallback, to a commit before detached checkout.
5373.caveats: Historical desktop/macOS binary not tested; trusted main was reproduced directly on Linux in two clean checkouts.
